explanation: A king of Judah who sought God and carried out religious reforms to remove idolatry.
To look for or try to find something; in this context, to seek God's guidance and presence.
A person who speaks on behalf of God and conveys divine messages to people.
In this context, it refers to the Spirit of God, a divine power that gives wisdom and guidance.
To restore or improve something; here it means to renew the covenant between God and the people.
An agreement or commitment between two parties, in this case between God and the people of Israel.
To remove or put an end to something; here it means to eliminate idolatry and unjust actions.
A celebration or observance of a special event; here it refers to a religious ceremony to honor God.
